summary: The filing reports the consummation of Snow Rothschild Acquisition Corp.'s initial public offering of 20,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for $200M gross proceeds, plus a partial over-allotment exercise of 2,600,000 units for an additional $26M. Each unit comprises one Class A share plus one-half warrant exercisable at $11.50/share. The associated agreements (underwriting, warrant, trust) are standard for a SPAC IPO. This is a routine capital formation event, not a special situation. There is no change of control, activist involvement, restructuring, or strategic review.
